feedback:
Decision: approve. This candidate is valid and well-supported by earlier races, and we are in early exploration with 8 iterations left, so racing it gives the most useful telemetry.

Why it is a sound test: (1) kd back to 0.30 is the value that gave the only progress gains so far. Iteration 1 (kd 0.30, +/-0.04 m sensors, base_speed 1.6) gave s-bend progress 0.157 and slalom 0.110, against 0.04 and 0.035 at kd 0.05 (iteration 0) and 0.04 and 0.035 at kd 0.15 (iteration 2). (2) The +/-0.05 m sensor spread is kept because iteration 2 cut oval line-loss events from 1 to 0 with weights unchanged. Oval progress was 0.115 in every iteration, so the oval is the main drag on the score and the spread is the only lever that has moved its line-loss count. (3) base_speed 1.4 is a single untested variable. Iteration 2 showed max_error 0.0614 on the oval at speed 1.6, just over the 0.06 m limit, so slower entry into the first corner is a plausible fix.

Weakness to watch: the candidate combines the kd return with the sensor spread and the speed change. Iteration 2 showed the spread alone did not lift oval progress above 0.115, and iteration 1 showed kd 0.30 alone left the oval unchanged, so the speed change is the main unknown for the oval. Its score is 52.35 at best so far (iteration 1), so read this race against that. Do not state a result for this candidate in planning; use the telemetry as follows.

Next step depends on the race. (a) If s-bend and slalom progress fall below the iteration 1 values (0.157 and 0.110), speed 1.4 is slowing the robot or stalling it; return base_speed to 1.6 and keep kd 0.30. (b) If oval max_error stays at or above 0.06 with line_loss_events 0, try sensor_size 0.016 before changing speed again. (c) If line_loss_events stays at 1 on s-bend or slalom, change line_loss to search_right or search_left with all other fields fixed. (d) If steering_oscillation rises well above 0.15, lower kd to about 0.20 rather than cutting kp.
requested_changes: If s-bend or slalom progress falls below iteration 1 (0.157 and 0.110 at kd 0.30, speed 1.6), set base_speed back to 1.6 and keep kd 0.30 and the +/-0.05 m sensors.

If oval max_error stays at or above 0.06 with line_loss_events 0, set sensor_size to 0.016 at base_speed 1.4, since the 0.012 footprint may be too small to keep the 25 mm tape in view on the first corner.

If line_loss_events stays at 1 on s-bend or slalom, change controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_right or search_left with all other fields fixed, because last_direction has produced one loss per run on every track in iterations 0 to 2.
